name: wai-hint-adherence-smoke
provenance: ticket evallerina-e10 (smoke Must gate). Recorded live against wai 2026.10.5 on 2026-10-09 in a scratch $TMPDIR directory: `wai status --json` fails with envelope E000 whose data.remediation suggests `wai doctor`; following the hint still fails (doctor cannot fix an uninitialized project); the root-cause fix `wai init --json` succeeds with ok:true. Channel note: wai carries remediation hints under data.remediation, not a top-level hints array.
